description: Every main stage has someone in it
Every exit stage has someone in it
INTERESTED after a later stage: no funnel step, furthest stage kept, active, never stuck
Created at INTERESTED: out of the cohort until a ranked stage, active, not counted as unmapped
A reminder value nests under its parent and counts as the parent's stage
A reminder move restarts neither the stage clock nor the stay
A renamed value with an alias makes no reconcile row
An unmapped raw stage has its own total row, is never a funnel step and is not active
People whose every stage is unmapped go in cohortExcludedUnmapped
Unmapped start, then mapped: in the cohort, entered at the move
No stage: No stage row, in total contacts, not active, not in the cohort
No stage, then assigned: entered at the assignment
Signed Paid and Signed Non paid nest under one success stage and both count as success
Stage total top rows sum to total contacts
Normal step inside the window counts as reached
Late step: timed out at this step, still enters the next
Skipped stages count as reached and have no stay
Backward move: furthest stage kept, clock runs from the latest arrival
Exit inside the window counts as exited
Exit outside the window reads as timed out
No move past the window reads as timed out
A to B to C merged before any sync: one row, B counts as skipped
A to B seen by a sync, then merged to A to C: rows A to B and B to C
A to B to A merged before any sync: a stored no-op every read ignores
A to B seen by a sync, then merged to A to A: rows A to B and B to A
Reconcile-only change: flagged row, counts for reached and movement, not durations
Reconcile skips people updated in the last 30 minutes, the next run catches them
Silent change with no transition at all: nothing to compare, no row
Reopened after an exit: the exit does not count at a stage entered later
Timeline rows the sync must ignore: creation, other field, linked record, no person, before tracking start
A row changing stage and another field is read, and only the stage is copied
Rerunning sync and daily adds no transition, snapshot or report
A late row inside the 30 minute overlap is read by the next sync
A late row older than the overlap is read only by the daily full re-read
Reconcile rows do not move the sync cursor
Too recent inside a step window: in window, out of the rate, counted in so far
Too recent for overall conversion though old enough for the steps
Old enough for all: counted in overall conversion, with or without success
Stuck: over the limit in whole days, with days over
Exactly at the limit is not stuck; exactly at the window is eligible
Imported with no move: counted inactive, not listed, not stuck
Imported person who moves on the timeline: in movement, never in the cohort
Imported person moved by reconcile: at least N days, lower bound
Imported, active, moved, no row for the current stage: clock unknown, neither stuck nor inactive
Created exactly at tracking start is in the cohort; a row exactly at tracking start is read
Created one second before tracking start is imported
A late-night change falls on a different local day in a non-UTC zone
A move exactly at the end of the window counts as reached
An exit exactly at the end of the window counts as exited
Overall conversion boundaries: entered exactly 90 days ago, success at 90 days counts, at 91 does not
Success, exit and OTHER stages have no limit, so nobody old there is stuck
Imported at an exit is not active, so not inactive
Stuck list sorted by days over limit, names read live
One position: one program row, one track row
Several positions in one track: once in the track, in several but not several tracks
Several positions across tracks: once per track, in several tracks
No position: NULL and empty both read as key NONE
Unmapped position: track key UNMAPPED, raw program row, marked unmapped
Every one of the 5 tracks is present
A program below the minimum sample is marked under minimum
A program at or above the minimum sample is not marked
Lowest step needs the minimum; the first step is excluded only if another qualifies; none qualifying gives null
A known source has its own row
An unknown source keeps its raw value as the row key, marked unmapped; there is no shared UNMAPPED source key, and filters use the raw value
No source reads as key NONE, and source rows add up to distinct people
A submission from the Internship Application form counts
A submission from another form does not count
Current and previous periods split at the local midnight
A person with two submissions counts twice as applications, once as a person
A soft-deleted submission does not count
A soft-deleted person's submission does not count, with or without a person filter
Imported Applications are a total only, without soft-deleted rows
An imported person's new submission counts as a new application
Soft deleted: out of every count, transitions stay
Soft deleted and restored: counts drop and return, no new transition
Sentinel names reach no analytics table or report, and on the page only stuck row names
Sentinel emails reach no analytics table, report or page payload
Sentinel form answers reach no analytics table, report or page payload
Stage field missing: NO_STAGE_FIELD, log row skipped, no error
Stage field of a wrong type is treated as missing
TEXT stage and source are accepted, free text reads as unmapped
Positions and source fields missing: funnel works, categories only have NONE
Form objects missing: new applications null, trend unavailable
Form objects half built: treated as missing, no error
A second workspace never leaks into the first, numbers or sync cursor
No people at all: zeros, null rates, consistency NOT_RUN
Off switch: jobs skip with no log row, page DISABLED, on again recovers
Before any job: NEVER_SYNCED, reads create nothing
No Applications object: imported applications null
Status filter: every value
Track filter
Program filter
Source filter, including NONE and a raw unknown value
Date filter on current state: created in range, imported people reported apart
Date filter bases: cohorts by application date, volume by submission, movement by event
Snapshot rows: every dimension, key NONE and UNMAPPED, stage empty for no stage
The first snapshot of a local date stands: consistency OK, then NOT_RUN, even with a new person and key
The snapshot date is the local date in the reporting zone
Snapshot metrics read the last snapshot in each bucket, null with none
New applications by bucket, with the previous buckets; null, not 0, for a bucket that ends before tracking start
Rate metrics by application cohort, null until mature, not offered daily
Median days by the date a stay ended, rounded to one decimal
Cohort table by application week and month, cut to the trend window, mature cells marked
Movement table: entered, left and now, reconcile rows included
Two category filters on a snapshot metric: unavailable, not wrong
Median days excludes open stays, stays touching a reconcile row and skipped stages
Only finished periods, oldest first, at most 8 per run
A stored report stays frozen
Weekly report numbers equal the same calculation at the time it was generated
Monthly report numbers, with cohorts
Comparisons: counts against the previous period, significant only at the minimum
Sync state comes from sync rows only: stale, young and old running rows
Log rows older than 90 days are trimmed by the daily job
The first sync enqueues the daily baseline, later ones do not
A failed job writes a failed row and rethrows; the next run recovers
Signed figure null while switched off, both raw values when on
The contract's hand-calculated sample table
Loaders refuse any host other than localhost or 127.0.0.1, and CRM mode needs its flag
No stage has a limit: the list falls back to the longest stays, with a notice
Whole days for the stuck limit, exact times for funnel windows: 14 days and 6 hours is neither stuck nor in time
A submission with no linked person counts in the headline and in no category row
Meta lists stage definitions, tracks, programs and source options for the filters
